user.title: Add a Google TV
user.description: On the TV, turn on Settings → System → Developer options → USB debugging (and Network or Wireless debugging where it's a separate switch). When you submit, the TV shows "Allow USB debugging?": tick Always allow and choose Allow. This waits up to a minute for it.

data_description.host: The TV's IP address or host name.
data_description.port: The TV's ADB port, 5555 unless you changed it.
data_description.name: Optional. The TV's maker and model when empty.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer trusts Home Assistant (debugging was turned off and on, or the TV was reset). Make sure USB debugging is on, submit, then tick Always allow and choose Allow on the TV.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: {name} ({host}) has network debugging on. Submit, then on the TV tick Always allow and choose Allow when it asks "Allow USB debugging?". This waits up to a minute for it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Change {name}'s address or ADB port. If the TV asks "Allow USB debugging?", tick Always allow and choose Allow.

data_description.host: The TV's IP address or host name.
data_description.port: The TV's ADB port, 5555 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the TV. Check its address and that network debugging is on.
error.not_authorized: The TV didn't allow the connection. Submit again and accept the prompt on the TV within a minute.

abort.already_configured: This TV is already set up.
abort.adb_off: Network debugging is off on this TV.
abort.wrong_device: That's a different TV. Add it as a new device instead.

data.online_lookups: Look up app icons and artwork online

data_description.online_lookups: Names and icons of the TV's apps from Google Play, and covers and posters for what's playing from iTunes and TVmaze. Off keeps everything on your network.

command_failed.message: The TV didn't take the command: {error}

unknown_source.message: The TV has no app or input called {source}.

unsupported_media_type.message: Google TV plays an app, an input or a url, not {media_type}.

unreachable.message: The TV is off its network and Home Assistant doesn't know its network address (MAC) to wake it. Turn on its network standby (Sony: Remote start) so it stays reachable.
